WAF Integration Test

This page is used by Playwright E2E tests to verify the CloudFront + WAF integration.

Selectable Text

Etymology is the study of the origin of words and how their meanings have changed throughout history. Select this text and use "Explain with AI" to test the WAF-protected API endpoint.

Test Scenario:
  1. Extension loads with CloudFront endpoint
  2. Domain is added to allowlist
  3. User selects text above
  4. Context menu "Explain with AI" triggers API call
  5. Request includes X-Aletheia-Client-Version: 1.0 header
  6. WAF allows request (header valid)
  7. Lambda processes and responds
  8. Success overlay appears (green border)
